shots.focal_element: Single centered word 'Meet' over a shallow-focus close-up of beige linen curtains
shots.transition_other: video start (no incoming transition); opens directly on the curtain plate
shots.typography: Small white sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case, normal tracking, centered; font guess (low confidence): a neutral grotesk
shots.what_happens: Opens on softly lit, defocused linen curtains with a slow drift; after about half a second the word 'Meet' appears centered and holds. The last contact-sheet frame (1.5 s) already shows the ring-on-table plate, so the change to s002 appears to happen slightly before the detected boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Full-bleed shallow-depth-of-field fabric plate with a slow lateral drift, then fade in a small centered white sans-serif word ~0.5 s in and hold until the cut.

shots.focal_element: Silver Oura Ring standing on a light-oak bedside table, with the 'Oura Ring 4' wordmark above it
shots.typography: White sans-serif, regular weight, title case, normal tracking, centered above the product; the numeral 4 sits inside a solid white circle badge (inverted digit)
shots.what_happens: Product hero: the ring rests on a warm wooden table with a long soft shadow and a blurred lamp and bed behind; the 'Oura Ring 4' name completes the 'Meet' line from s001. The 3.0 s frame already shows the macro ring-interior render, so the move into s003 starts before the detected boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Static product hero shot with low raking light, ring centered in the lower third and a centered white wordmark with a circled numeral placed just above it, held for about 1.3 s.

shots.focal_element: Macro render of the ring interior showing the sensor windows, with light beams and a dot-matrix particle wave and the centered word 'Incredible'
shots.typography: White sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case for 'Incredible'; the accent word 'accuracy' is set in a light italic serif and appears second, mixing two typefaces in one line
shots.what_happens: The camera looks down into the ring from above as the sensor windows glow and shoot warm light beams across the inside, with a fine dot-grid shimmer sweeping around the band. 'Incredible' sits centered, then the italic-serif 'accuracy' is added on the right by about 4.5 s.
shots.build_rebuild: Top-down 3D macro of the ring interior with emissive sensor pads and volumetric light sweeps plus a dot-grid particle pass; fade in 'Incredible' centered, then reveal an italic-serif accent word after it about 1 s later.

shots.shot_type_other: transition shot: crossfade from the 3D ring-interior render to a bedroom footage plate
shots.focal_element: Dissolve between the ring interior ('Incredible accuracy') and a symmetrical bedroom wall with an art panel above the bed
shots.typography: Same as s003: white regular sans-serif 'Incredible' plus italic-serif accent word 'accuracy'; the text is visible in the keyframe but gone in the 5.0 s frame
shots.what_happens: Short 0.66 s bridge: the mid-shot keyframe still shows the ring interior with 'Incredible accuracy', while the 5.0 s frame shows a calm, symmetrical bedroom (green duvet, two lamps, textured white art panel) with no text. I could not see the blend itself, only its two ends.
shots.build_rebuild: Crossfade the ring-interior render, with its caption, into a static symmetrical bedroom plate over about 0.6 s, fading the caption out with the outgoing layer.

shots.focal_element: Line 'For your best sleep' centered over the white art panel above the bed
shots.typography: White sans-serif, regular weight, sentence case for 'For your best'; the accent word 'sleep' is set in a light italic serif at lower opacity, revealed after the sans words
shots.what_happens: A near-static, symmetrical bedroom shot with a very slight push. 'For your best' sits centered on the art panel; at about 6.5 s the italic-serif 'sleep' fades in to finish the line, repeating the sans-plus-serif-accent pattern from s003.
shots.build_rebuild: Symmetrical bedroom plate with a slow 1-2% scale push; place a centered white sans phrase, then fade in a lighter italic-serif accent word to its right about 1 s later and hold.

shots.focal_element: The ring caught in the folds of white bed linen, tilted to show its inner sensors
shots.what_happens: Close-up of the ring resting in the upper-left third among rumpled white sheets against a warm beige background. The fabric shifts slightly between frames, which reads as gentle motion or a slow camera drift. There is no text.
shots.build_rebuild: Soft-lit macro of the product nestled in white linen in the upper-left third, with a slow drift or fabric movement for about 0.9 s and no overlay text.
